$comment: SUBSTRATE = the carved terrain a set piece is authored on top of: the floor
inside the room and the wall ring around it. It is NOT part of the set-piece
def - map generation writes those tiles - but every tool that previews a set
piece has to draw it, or props get judged against the wrong background.
This file exists because that went wrong three times in three renderers:
the Set Piece Lab hardcoded cool blue-grey STONE_FLOOR, the Set Piece Editor
drew a black void plus a Kenney placeholder wall ring, and only the game drew
the real warm-orange SAFE_ROOM_FLOOR. A prop reviewed on black, on blue-grey,
and on orange is three different props.
Sprite ids here are pinned against the engine's own terrain->art resolution
silently drift from what the game actually stamps.

welcome-room.note: Carved STONE_FLOOR then repainted to SAFE_ROOM_FLOOR by tagRoomAsSafe.
